objective: Minimize repeated wind-query cost subject to numerical velocity and coverage targets. Charge offline CFD and table loading separately.
method: At each fixed common-air world position, rotate both training vectors into their wind-aligned frames, linearly interpolate the components in wind-from angle, then rotate back to the requested world frame. Never extrapolate.
cfd_selection: Try the existing production mesh against the strict reference for each training direction. Prefer the cheaper field if it passes the regional fidelity, convergence and source-support checks. A checked strict field can supply the table if the cheaper field cannot qualify. Use an independent strict solve for the holdout.
evaluation: Score the held-out direction at fixed world points. Include every reference-valid point of a scored region in the coverage denominator. Report masked and unsampled positions separately. Retain provisional or failed runs outside the released fields.
interpretation: This directional pilot extends the single-condition coupled study. The study's provisional error and coverage cutoffs are used as engineering targets. No operational flight tolerance has been established.
comparison_methods: Linear blend of world-frame endpoint vectors at the same position

secondary_holdout.selection: Reserved after both strict midpoint solves timed out, before generating any NbE field. This heading bisects the interval from the checked north field to the primary holdout. Test the already frozen N/NE model without refitting. Report alongside the unqualified primary holdout, irrespective of the outcome.
secondary_holdout.budget: One strict solve with the existing resource limits. One localized mesh repair is allowed if required by the existing mesh gates.

midpoint_recovery.workload: Cold start, strict 22.5-degree SIMPLEC case. Keep the forcing, geometry, turbulence closure, reference inflow, queries and coupled acceptance checks fixed. Any mesh change must pass the existing geometry and force-support checks.
midpoint_recovery.measurement: python3 scenes/joint/study.py solve --case CASE; after convergence run the sample and evaluate stages on the terminal iterate.
midpoint_recovery.acceptance: A checked terminal reference within 600 s for the solve, 600 s for meshing, 3 CPUs and 5 GiB. Preserve p <= 1e-4 and U, k, epsilon <= 1e-5, flux, monitor, rotor-wake and force checks. Unconverged checkpoints are diagnostic only.
midpoint_recovery.stop: At most three sequential hypothesis attempts. Stop on a checked reference, a binding protocol limit, or insufficient evidence for another change.

future_split.use: If a new 22.5-degree anchor qualifies, compare the original 0/45 model with the split interval at the same previously unused heading. Keep the existing regional accuracy thresholds and reference-valid coverage denominator. No fitting or tuning on the reserved case.
